answer: Here is one mechanism: only answered epochs pay, each epoch's emission pool is fixed, and rewards split across verified answers, so extra volume dilutes rather than multiplies income. The required words slot into it cleanly: knoll captures the flow of attestations that gives each answer finality, river maps onto the transparency that makes every pattern visible, and island tracks the fixed size of each epoch's emission pool. Flooding the network buys a shrinking slice of a fixed pool while still burning real compute on every submission. Every shortcut has a metered cost on this network.
